status: Provisional researcher-selected themes and AI-assisted search terms; not a validated scholarly codebook.

themes.name: Education and workforce development
themes.definition: Education, student learning, educator preparation, or workforce training.
themes.review_rule: Job training belongs here; employment decisions also need the employment code.

themes.name: Synthetic media and likeness
themes.definition: Creation, alteration, distribution, or use of synthetic media or a person's likeness.
themes.review_rule: Ordinary images or incidental references to a likeness do not establish an AI connection.

themes.name: Public safety and justice
themes.definition: Public safety, policing, criminal conduct, or the use of AI in legal proceedings.
themes.review_rule: Generic court or evidence references need context before inclusion.

themes.name: Health and clinical decisions
themes.definition: Health services, clinical decisions, medical practice, or patient care.
themes.review_rule: Health-related budget language without a substantive AI connection is insufficient.

themes.name: Infrastructure funding and innovation
themes.definition: Funding, research, computing infrastructure, or innovation supporting AI.
themes.review_rule: General appropriations or infrastructure unrelated to AI should be excluded.

themes.name: Consumer protection and deception
themes.definition: Consumer transactions, deceptive practices, fraud, or consumer-facing AI disclosures.
themes.review_rule: Generic fraud or consumer language is insufficient without a relevant provision.

themes.name: Public governance and AI oversight
themes.definition: Government use of AI, AI oversight bodies, or government AI administration.
themes.review_rule: An agency merely enforcing an unrelated subject does not automatically qualify.

themes.name: Privacy and personal data
themes.definition: Collection, use, disclosure, or protection of personal or biometric information in an AI-related provision.
themes.review_rule: Routine confidentiality language without a relevant connection is insufficient.

themes.name: Employment and labor
themes.definition: Hiring, employee management, labor rights, or workplace use of AI.
themes.review_rule: Workforce education alone belongs under education; code both if both apply.

themes.name: National security and foreign technology
themes.definition: National-security concerns, foreign control, or restrictions on foreign technology and vendors.
themes.review_rule: Cybersecurity, foreign references, or generic vendors alone do not establish this theme.
